description:
Staff: lists the places the signed-in user is a member of, today the places of a business they created.
Start here for any staff task: businessId with placeId is what the staff tools take, and geoHash with
placeId is what get_place_services, find_booking_times and create_booking take.
name: list_my_places

places.description: Places the signed-in user is a member of; empty when the account's business has no place.

bookingEnabled.description: Whether the place takes bookings right now.

businessId.description: Business id; with placeId it is what the staff tools take.

geoHash.description: GeoHash of the place; with placeId it is what find_booking_times and create_booking take.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the place's dates and local times are read in.

title: My places (staff)
